meta.title: Oselia Studio — apartment and house renovation in Kyiv
meta.description: Turnkey renovation, interior design and finishing. Fixed estimate, weekly photo reports, 3-year warranty.

hero.lead: We design, renovate and hand over turnkey. The estimate is fixed in the contract, and every week you get a photo report from the site.
hero.imageAlt: Bright living room with a wooden coffee table and terracotta poufs
hero.badgeText: The contract price stays the same until the work is done

showcase.title: From sketch to reality
showcase.sketchAlt: Pencil sketch of a living room with a sofa and round mirrors
showcase.photoAlt: The same living room after the renovation

sketch.title: Measurements and sketches
sketch.text: We visit the site, take measurements and sketch every room.

materials.title: Materials and estimate
materials.text: We choose materials for your budget and fix the price in the contract.

build.title: Renovation and handover
build.text: We build to the design, report every week and hand over with a 3-year warranty.

services.title: We take care of the whole renovation
services.lead: From the first sketch to the final clean-up. One team, one contract and one person responsible for the result.

projects.title: Interiors we have already handed over
projects.lead: Every project started as a sketch. Open any of them to see what it looked like on paper.

calculator.title: Estimate your renovation in a minute
calculator.lead: Choose the area, the type of renovation and any extras. The rates come from our current price list.
calculator.note: Materials not included. The exact sum goes into the contract after a free site visit.

faq.title: Answers before you ask
faq.lead: Did not find your answer? Write to us and we will reply within an hour during working hours.

contact.title: Tell us about your place
contact.lead: We call back within 30 minutes during working hours and book a free site visit.
